capabilities: Build an editable, draggable grid homepage with configurable widgets
Aggregate active projects, tasks, and recent notes from vault folders and frontmatter
Track pomodoro focus time and attribute it to projects, areas, or task pools
Generate a capability map from Value, Area, and Project note relationships
Save, load, and switch named layouts for devices or scenarios
extras: Bilingual English/Simplified Chinese interface. The Music Player widget only opens a configured external music service page rather than playing audio itself; TimeLog data is stored locally in the plugin data file.
problem: Obsidian opens on files or notes by default and has no built-in start page that surfaces active projects, tasks, focus time, and knowledge status at a glance.

relations.evidence: the Activity History widget embeds an ActivityHistory code block that is rendered by the optional community plugin Activity History
Needed only when a System widget button is configured to run a QuickAdd command.
Needed only when a System item uses the daily-note action
Visual design inspired by Dashboard-Komorebi.css (Komorebi / Catppuccin style) by InlitX.

summary: Widget-based homepage dashboard that opens at startup with a draggable grid of widgets for projects, tasks, habits, pomodoro focus, and notes.
